senses.gloss: (a popular perversion of διαδοχή, as though = דְּיוֹ זוּגֵי two sets, v. דְּיוֹ II) succession in government, surrender of office.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 13b:19">Sot. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>אותה שבת של ד׳ היתה וכ׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="D00508"><he>דיוזגי</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 941">Yalk. Deut. 941</cite> <cite ref="D00508"><he>דיוזגו</he></cite>) it was the week of transmission of office when the office was taken from the one (Moses) and given to the other (Joshua, hence ‘Moses and Joshua went’ &c., <cite ref="Deuteronomy 31:14">Deut. XXXI, 14</cite>); v. <cite ref="D00581"><he>דייתיכוס</he></cite>.
